an3.59:1.1: Then the brahmin Jāṇussoṇī approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
an3.59:1.2: “Master Gotama, whoever has a sacrifice, a memorial meal, an offering dish, or something to be given should give the gift to brahmins who are masters of the threefold knowledge.”
an3.59:1.3: The Blessed One said: “But how, brahmin, do the brahmins describe a brahmin who is a master of the threefold knowledge?”
an3.59:1.4: “Here, Master Gotama, a brahmin is well born on both sides … as in AN3.58 … and skilled in the marks of a great man.
an3.59:1.5: It is in this way that the brahmins describe a master of the threefold knowledge.”
an3.59:2.1: “Brahmin, a master of the threefold knowledge in the Noble One’s discipline is quite different from the one that the brahmins describe.”
an3.59:2.2: “But in what way, Master Gotama, is one a master of the threefold knowledge in the Noble One’s discipline?
an3.59:2.3: It would be good if Master Gotama would teach me the Dhamma in such a way as to make clear how one is a master of the threefold knowledge in the Noble One’s discipline.”
an3.59:2.4: “Well then, brahmin, listen and attend closely. I will speak.”
an3.59:6.7: This is the third true knowledge attained by him.
an3.59:6.8: Ignorance is dispelled, true knowledge has arisen; darkness is dispelled, light has arisen, as happens when one dwells heedful, ardent, and resolute.
an3.59:8.2: who sees heaven and the plane of misery,
an3.59:8.3: and has reached the destruction of birth
an3.59:8.4: is a sage consummate in direct knowledge.
an3.59:9.3: I call him a triple-knowledge master,
an3.59:9.4: not the other who utters incantations.
an3.59:10.1: “It is in this way, brahmin, that one is a master of the threefold knowledge in the Noble One’s discipline.”
an3.59:10.2: “A master of the threefold knowledge in the Noble One’s discipline, Master Gotama, is quite different from a master of the threefold knowledge according to the brahmins.
an3.59:10.3: And a master of the threefold knowledge according to the brahmins is not worth a sixteenth part of a master of the threefold knowledge in the Noble One’s discipline.
an3.59:11.2: Let Master Gotama consider me a lay follower who from today has gone for refuge for life.”
